- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided packing tips such as rolling clothes, packing mix-and-match outfits, and wearing bulky items on the plane.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested lightweight materials for jackets: cotton, linen, rayon, and Tencel.
